import sys
from array import array


def read_ints():
    # Parse the input in 1 MiB chunks into a compact int64 array.
    read = sys.stdin.buffer.read
    values = array("q")
    rest = b""
    while True:
        chunk = read(1 << 20)
        if not chunk:
            break
        chunk = rest + chunk
        cut = max(chunk.rfind(b" "), chunk.rfind(b"\n"))
        if cut < 0:
            rest = chunk
            continue
        rest = chunk[cut:]
        values.extend(map(int, chunk[:cut].split()))
    values.extend(map(int, rest.split()))
    return values


def main():
    data = read_ints()
    n = data[0]
    h = data[1:n + 1]
    h.append(0)  # sentinel pops everything at the end
    del data
    # ponytail: one monotonic-stack pass; each entry keeps the leftmost index its height spans,
    # so a popped bar's maximal width is i - start (same candidates as separate left/right passes).
    starts = array("q")  # typed stacks: a 3e6-deep staircase would not fit as int objects
    heights = array("q")
    best = 0
    i = 0
    for x in h:
        start = i
        while heights and heights[-1] >= x:
            hj = heights.pop()
            start = starts.pop()
            side = i - start
            if hj < side:
                side = hj
            if side > best:
                best = side
        starts.append(start)
        heights.append(x)
        i += 1
    print(best * best)


main()
